elements.markdown: We know p95 crossed 10 seconds after a deployment. That timing does not establish the cause, and the prior downstream incident is only a lead. I can inspect dashboards and logs now; rollback, scaling, and production setting changes require explicit authorization after we identify a concrete action.

elements.multi: What should the read-only investigation cover?

options.description: Build a reliable before/after comparison, including traffic changes; test whether the deployment explains the regression.
Read logs and any available traces to locate where requests stall; report missing instrumentation.
Separate slow endpoints and traffic classes, then inspect resource pressure before considering capacity changes.
Look for current dependency failures without assuming the previous incident has recurred.

reveals.multi: Which possibilities should I assess against the evidence?

options.description: Assess whether the deployed change caused the regression and whether reverting it is viable.
Assess only if saturation explains the delay; identify expected benefit and added cost.
Consider a specific setting only if telemetry supports it; describe the risk and reversal.

reveals.text: These selections request recommendations only. I will bring back the supporting evidence and exact proposed action for explicit authorization before changing production.
